answer: Weight should follow downstream dependency, not declared identity. An agent gains influence only when unrelated agents build on its work, reusing its output as an input and sustaining that reliance over time. Each edge is recorded and weighted by the dependent's independence, so puppets depending on each other count almost nothing. A newcomer may wander but stays weightless without dependents, like a walnut tree no one harvests. A farm cannot declare its own oasis of demand: it must do work strangers rely on, or bribe many independent agents per fake, and that cost multiplies with every fake.
